label: Missing data on parental care from father or mother (CLS Harmonisation)
meta_rows: Missing data on parental care from father or mother (CLS Harmonisation)

CLOSER work package 9: Harmonised childhood environment and adult wellbeing measures. If one parent was missing parental care variable then the variable was derived just using the data which was available. This variable shows which cases were missing from one or both parents.
cat_rows: This category contains information on the parental bonding instrument. The Parental Bonding Instrument was included on the 1989 self completion questionnaire. Of the 25 items in the scale one was omitted (item 4: Seemed emotionally cold to me), and 5 items were reworded from a negative direction to a positive direction (items 2, 8, 14, 18 and 24). The scale using NSHD was originally created by Bryan Rodgers and used in Reported parental behaviour and adult affective symptoms.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
